summary: Implemented acceptance-first serial drafting for TASK-0093: AcceptanceDraft now freezes and snapshots the ClaimGraph digest before RequirementDraft, RequirementDraft receives the boundary contract and frozen ClaimGraph as read-only input, RequirementDraft ClaimGraph rewrites including falsey-present values are rejected, and PlanDraft claimRefs must resolve against the frozen ClaimGraph. Added the boundary entry ID helper and updated Workflow A CLI timeout evidence to AcceptanceDraft.
